ES:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Se siente, sirenita, pero este capitán
ya está cogido.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Harrr, was du für hübsch funkelnde
Äuglein hast, {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Se hai bisogno di qualcosa dimmelo
pure.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Per gli amici ci sono sempre.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}If I was yer father, I'd be proud of
the interest ye take in the sea!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
FR:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Si j'avais une gamine aussi distraite
qu'toi, j'la surveillerais de près !{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ma non ti hanno mai detto di non
parlare con gli sconosciuti?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Baban olsaydım, denize böyle ilgi
duymanla gurur duyardım!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Listen to 'ol Kapp'n. Take good care
o' yer mum and pop!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Ascolta un consiglio dal capitano
Remo... {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}La famiglia è tutto!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}İhtiyar Kapp’n’ı dinle. Annenle
babana iyi bak!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}So I bet yer the belle o' the town.
I knows cute when I sees it!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Scommetto tutti i miei remi
che sei la bella del paese!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Bahse girerim kasabanın gözdesisin.
Güzeli görünce anlarım!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Mmmh,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} du riechst echt wie 'n
Engel, Kleine!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Hangi şampuanı kullanıyorsun bilmem
ama melek gibi kokuyorsun!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

DE:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Du bist 'ne echte Abenteurerin,
nicht wahrrr?{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Are ye the shy type, lassie? Yer not
sayin' much.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Sei un po' timida, sirenetta?
Non hai spiccicato parola...{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Utangaç mısın kızım? Pek bir şey
söylemiyorsun.{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Don't be nervous, {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}! I've
sailed these seas a thousand times!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
ES:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}¡No temas, {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}! ¡Estas aguas
ya no guardan secretos para mí!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Gerilme, {{TAG:0011:0000:0000}}! Bu sularda
bin kez yol aldım!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Har har! I just noticed how cute you
are!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Che onore trasportare questa
bella sirenetta!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Har har! Ne kadar tatlı olduğunu
yeni fark ettim!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Thar be no charms like a woman's
charms. Use 'em wisely!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Bir kadının cazibesi gibisi yoktur.
Akıllıca kullan!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}

EN:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Traveling alone, eh? Yar, that's the
life. Free as a seabird!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
IT:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}In viaggio da sola, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} E perché no!
Che bella la sensazione di libertà...{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0007:0004:}}Tek başına geziyorsun, ha? Arr, hayat
bu işte. Deniz kuşu kadar özgür!{{TAG:0007:0005:}}
